body:
Found by Model movements testing the picked models. All four fixed 31 Oct (book v142); they were broken, so no pick was needed:
1) Stairs: both staircases moved 0.4 back, so 0.8 is free in front (player 0.5 wide); every step now rises evenly and the top step is level with the floor above (checked in code: 3.42 and 6.62).
2) Owl perch: moved onto the branch, out of the leaf ball; the owl sits on it.
3) Seal: pool 3.6 x 2.6 (was 3.0 x 2.3), taller ladder tower, slide 0.9 wide into the water.
4) Snake hide: 0.88 wide inside (was 0.64), the coiled snake (0.71) fits.
Check in Model Compare → Pet Shop and Snake home (🔔).
short: Check: shop stairs, owl perch, seal pool, snake hide fixed
title: Pet Shop and terrarium fixes
